## Gait Libraries: Hybrid-Zero Dynamics {.nav-approach}

![](../media/framework_gl.svg){.absolute top=-30 right=-60 width="30%" style="z-index: 10;"}

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}
Utilize FROST to generate gait $\mathcal{X}(\alpha)$ composed via Bézier polynomials.

Bézier polynomials are parametrized by *control points* $\alpha$.

Create a *gait library* as a organized collection of $\mathcal{X}_i$
:::

::: {.column width="50%" style="font-size: 0.7em; margin-top: 0em;"}
\begin{align}
    \overbrace{\mathcal{X}(\alpha)^*}^{\textrm{Joint Trajectories}} = ~&\underset{X(\alpha)}{\textrm{argmin}} ~\overbrace{\mathcal{J}(X(\alpha))}^{Cost} \notag \\
   \textrm{s.t.} & \quad \textrm{Closed Loop Dynamics} \\
    & \quad \textrm{Impact Invariance} \\
    & \quad \textrm{Physical Feasibility}  \\
    & \quad \textrm{Additional Constraints}
\end{align}

![](../media/gl.svg){style="margin-top: -1em;"}
:::
